data.name: Sikandra
data.gender_notes: Sikandra is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Shikhandi', the name of a legendary warrior in Hindu mythology. Shikhandi was a man born as a woman due to a curse, and he was known for his strength, bravery, and ability to defeat his enemies. The name Sikandra carries the meaning “Victory over Enemies” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sikandra usually hope their child will grow to embody victory over enemies and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of transformation and the ability to overcome challenges and adversities in life.
data.etymology: Sikandra belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory over Enemies.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sikandra total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Sikandra is believed to have originated in India, particularly in the northern regions. Its connection to the legendary figure Shikhandi in Hindu mythology suggests a deep-rooted cultural appreciation for warrior strength, transformative power, and triumph over odds. This name therefore embodies the spirit of resilience and courage prominent in traditional Indian culture.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu philosophy, the name Sikandra serves as a reminder of the concept of transitory existence and the power of the human soul to transcend limited physical form. The legend of Shikhandi, who was born as a woman out of necessity but undoubtedly held the strength and prowess of a man, illustrates the capacity of the soul to express itself in various forms and adapt to changing circumstances. This spiritual significance highlights the transformative power of the self and the understanding that genuine strength comes from within.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Sikandra: Victory of the Auspicious Sign. This name signifies the bearer's triumph over obstacles, instilling confidence and hope in facing life's challenges. The auspicious sign is a reminder of the divine guidance and blessings that accompany the journey.
